name: Managing Emotions
overview: Scripture teaches that managing emotions is deeply connected to walking in the Spirit rather than following the flesh, as Paul emphasizes in Romans and Galatians. Believers are called to respond to others with honesty and refrain from repaying evil with evil, reflecting the fruit of the Spirit which includes love, joy, peace, and longsuffering. Even in anger, Ephesians instructs to avoid sin and resolve conflicts promptly, trusting the LORD as our shepherd who provides and sustains us in all circumstances.
